Microhomology-mediated end joining.question: There are multiple pathways for repairing double strand breaks, mainly non-homologous end joining (_____), homologous recombination (HR), and MMEJ
Microhomology-mediated end joining.fact: Microhomology-mediated end joining (MMEJ), also called alternative nonhomologous end-joining (Alt-NHEJ) is one of the pathways for repairing double-strand breaks in DNA. Microhomology-mediated end joining.question: This results in frequent deletions and occasionally insertions which are much larger than those produced by _____

This results in frequent deletions and occasionally insertions which are much larger than those produced by NHEJ.

Microhomology-mediated end joining.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Microhomology-mediated end joining.question: In _____, repair of the DSB is initiated by end resection by the MRE nuclease, leaving single stranded overhangs
Microhomology-mediated end joining.fact: MMEJ is distinguished from these other repair mechanisms by its use of microhomologous sequences to align the broken strands. MMEJ is completely independent from classical NHEJ and does not rely on NHEJ core factors such as Ku protein, DNA-PK, or Ligase IV.
